basic_info.description: Perched on the corner of De Haro and 18th Street, 600-602 De Haro is detached on three sides and commands an enviable location in North Potrero Hill. A large and mature front garden surrounds the building which is set back and up from the street. 600 De Haro, the vacant and larger of the two units, is a unique home with amazing character and space on three levels. A gracious foyer greets you at the entry level with a rack for hanging coats and ample room to kick off your shoes. One bright bedroom is on this level with internal access to the one+ car garage. Up the stairs is the main level with an add'l bedroom benefitting from a lightwell, full-sized windows and access to the deck and verdant side yard. Down the hall is a bath with vintage tub and a window into the lightwell. You'll spend all your time in the great room which features a voluminous space with open beams, rich softwood floors, city views, four skylights and dazzling eastern and southern light. The efficient kitchen opens into the great room so you can serve your guests and still be a part of the conversation. A spiral staircase leads to a large third bedroom with a walk-in closet, second bath and add'l space. The second unit at 602 De Haro is a tenant-occupied studio on two levels with shared yard access.
